style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=13;fontColor=#1A1A1A;labelBackgroundColor=none;" value="IMPORT CONTRACT
• Each CSV row is one item; sale_id groups a transaction. Product IDs are unique within a company.
• Required columns: sale_id, date_time, product_id, product, category, quantity, unit_price, unit_cost.
• One file belongs to the selected company. A sale cannot mix companies or transaction timestamps.
• Quantity must be a positive integer; prices/costs must be finite and nonnegative; reject invalid or missing values.
• Reject duplicate (sale_id, product_id) rows; aggregate units into quantity before import. Validate the whole file before creating objects.
• Historical unit prices/costs belong to SaleItem. Filtered datasets may reference the same sales." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="1480" x="60" y="1010" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> <diagram name="2 - Analytics" id="p1"> <mxGraphModel dx="1500" dy="1000" grid="1" gridSize="10" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1600" pageHeight="1240" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" value="" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" value="" /> <mxCell id="title" value="02 / Analytics and results" style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=24;fontColor=#243247;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="20" width="1500" height="40" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="subtitle" value="INITIAL DELIVERY • All Analysis subclasses implement run(data) → AnalysisResult. Hollow triangle points to the base class.

ASSOCIATION
Solid line connects related objects.
An open arrow indicates navigation.
Without an arrow, navigation is unspecified.

COMPOSITION
Filled diamond is at the whole.
A part belongs to at most one whole
at a time; its lifecycle follows that whole.

DEPENDENCY
Dashed line with an open arrow points
to the class being used.

MULTIPLICITY
1 = exactly one
0..1 = zero or one
0..* = zero or many
1..* = one or many
Read the number next to a class as
how many of its objects may be linked
to one object at the opposite end." style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=16;fontColor=#243247;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1050" y="150" width="470" height="810" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="footer" value="DESIGN PROPOSAL • Keep the initial diagram aligned with the first implementation; revise future designs as requirements evolve." style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=13;fontColor=#243247;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="60" y="1010" width="1400" height="70" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
IMPORT CONTRACT
• Each CSV row is one item; sale_id groups a transaction. Product IDs are unique within a company.
• Required columns: sale_id, date_time, product_id, product, category, quantity, unit_price, unit_cost.
• One file belongs to the selected company. A sale cannot mix companies or transaction timestamps.
• Quantity must be a positive integer; prices/costs must be finite and nonnegative; reject invalid or missing values.
• Reject duplicate (sale_id, product_id) rows; aggregate units into quantity before import. Validate the whole file before creating objects.
• Historical unit prices/costs belong to SaleItem. Filtered datasets may reference the same sales.

• Reject duplicate (sale_id, product_id) rows; aggregate units into quantity before import. Validate the whole file before creating objects.
• Historical unit prices/costs belong to SaleItem. Filtered datasets may reference the same sales.
